newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Sept 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Sept 16.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following business stories on Monday:
* Contract neogotiations continued between Ford Motor Co and the United Auto Workers union following the expiration of their old contract.
* Bayer AG and Roche Holding are creating a joint venture in the United States to Roche's Aleve and other products.
* The CBS television network is implementing a strategy designed to lure older viewers back from cable television.
* Speculation is growing that Edmark Corp might be in play following the resignation of chief executive Sally Narodnick last week.
* The Wall Street Journal is about to start charging users of its site on the World Wide Web.
* Most Internet host sites are located in counties with large cities or universities.
* Lotus Development Corp, a unit of International Business Machines Corp, is fighting the perception that its Notes software is not as mature as that of other companies that are in fact much younger.
